bundle.shortDescription: Desktop workspace for qualitative research: audio transcription, document OCR, text analysis and RAG chat over your collections, with local and remote AI models.
bundle.longDescription: EntropIA Pro is a desktop research workspace for document and audio collections. It transcribes audio, extracts text from documents via OCR, runs NLP analysis (entities, triples, embeddings) and offers a RAG chat over the resulting knowledge base. ML features run on local models (Python runtime, on-device OCR) as well as remote providers.
